messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning: The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California (must close at or after 10 PM), also in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. They want to find them. We have a function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby that can locate nearby vegan restaurants based on location and operating_hours. It takes location string and optional operating_hours number default 21. So we can call it for each location with operating_hours=22? Actually they want at least 10 PM, so we set operating_hours=22. The function returns any. We need to call the function for each location. The user didn't specify a particular city name format but we can use "Los Angeles, CA" etc. The function expects location string like "New York, NY". So we can pass "Los Angeles, CA", "San Francisco, CA", "Seattle, WA". The operating_hours param is optional; we set it to 22. The function returns any. We'll call it three times. Then we need to respond with the results. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the function.
